desk.why: Implied is only 0.88x the forecast, below the 1.10x a seller needs.

facts: NIFTY moved +1.4% over the last 7 sessions and +0.6% on the day, to 25,465.
Almost no gap (-41 pts): the +277-pt body was built during the session, which is stronger evidence than an overnight jump.
The day closed at its high (close - low 359, high - close 28).
India VIX 16.70 (+7.3%) - rising on an up day: traders are paying for protection, the rally is nervous.
ATM IV sits in its 69th percentile of the past year: option premium is middling.

base.why: No trend worth leaning on (7-session move +1.4%), so the plan sells both sides at the writers' walls, 25,400 and 25,800, and lets time decay work. Note: the desk's volatility rule says stand aside today (Implied is only 0.88x the forecast, below the 1.10x a seller needs.). This plan overrides it only for the scenario branches; size down.
text: bull put spread: sell 25,000 PE, buy 24,800 PE (credit about 29 pts, Rs 1,856 per lot; max loss Rs 11,144)
bear call spread: sell 26,200 CE, buy 26,400 CE (credit about 20 pts, Rs 1,275 per lot; max loss Rs 11,725)

scenarios.title: Breaks out above 25,800
watch: 25,800 CE open interest falling (writers buying back - short covering)
Close near the day's high again
scenarios.means: The ceiling gave way. Next magnets: 26,000 then 26,600.
scenarios.action: Hold today's position. It would be about Rs 369 in loss per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell a spread, sell 25,800 PE / buy 25,600 PE. The old ceiling 25,800 becomes the floor: sell puts at it. No calls below 26,600. Or buy a spread: buy 25,900 CE / sell 26,600 CE. If it spikes past 26,000 in one session with VIX rising, take profit instead of chasing.
scenarios.odds: Reached 26,000 in 31.9% and 26,600 in 11.4% of past cases (normal 37.1% / 10.9%).

scenarios.title: Falls to 25,400 and holds
watch: 25,400 PE open interest still rising (put writers defending)
scenarios.action: If it holds: keep today's position, or add nothing (weekly). If it breaks: close today's position and switch to sell 25,400 CE / buy 25,600 CE (weekly). Exact strikes for every expiry are in the position matrix.
scenarios.odds: Dipped to 25,400 in 73.2% of past cases (normal 69.5%).

scenarios.title: Breaks down below 25,400
watch: 25,400 PE open interest falling (put writers exiting)
scenarios.means: The floor gave way. Next: 25,300 then 25,200.
scenarios.action: Close today's position. It would be about Rs 703 in profit per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell a spread, sell 25,400 CE / buy 25,600 CE. The old floor 25,400 becomes the ceiling: sell calls at it. Or buy a spread: buy 25,400 PE / sell 25,000 PE.
scenarios.odds: Dipped to 25,300 in 64.6% of past cases (normal 60.5%).

rules: Take profit on any spread once 50% of its credit is earned; the rest is not worth the risk.
Close any spread once its loss reaches 1.5x the credit taken, whatever day that is. Holding into expiry is fine; size smaller on expiry day.
Act on daily closes, not intraday spikes. The OI checks use the next morning's bhavcopy.
Credits for rolls and add-ons are set by prices on the day you act; today's numbers are a guide only.
limits: None of the desk's positioning signals (PCR, max pain, OI flow, walls) has passed its own backtest for this horizon, so the history study is the main evidence.
